entry.title: MPC AirLink 1.3.0
entry.summary: MPC AirLink 1.3.0 receives classic AirPlay or VBAN audio on an MPC plugin track. - Physical-style panel and one touch-controlled Output knob; Q-Link 1 controls volume. - Green knob focus and orange Q-Link bank outlines removed. - Meter sampling fixed at 24 Hz; no refresh selector. - VBAN Buffer moved to DIAG, default 120 ms for new instances; old projects retain their setting. AirPlay internal prebuffer is fixed at 120 ms separately. - AirPlay remains the default; VBAN accepts any stream name. S

entry.title: MPC AirLink 1.1.1
entry.summary: MPC AirLink 1.1.1 is a native VST2 instrument receiving classic AirPlay/RAOP or VBAN audio on an MPC plugin track. Changes since 1.0.0: - AirPlay is the default; the public selector offers AirPlay and VBAN. Saved AUTO maps to AirPlay. - New static dark card UI, original AIRLINK wordmark and CC0 AirPlay icon. - Complete LED blocks; 24 Hz meter sampling target with selectable 10 Hz mode, 120 ms release, and no notifications for unchanged states. - Separate status/meter deadlines and normal-priorit

entry.title: MPC AirLink 1.0.0
entry.summary: Native VBAN and classic AirPlay audio receiver for MPC Standalone, by sttm. - Green terminal UI with STREAM/DIAG tabs, AUTO / VBAN Only / AirPlay Only, jitter buffer, output gain and stereo meters. - VBAN: UDP 6980, any stream name, PCM16/24 and float32, mono/stereo, sample-rate conversion. Prefer 256-frame packets. - AirPlay: iPhone/Mac audio menu → MPC AirLink; no third-party iPhone app required. Classic RAOP audio, with approximately two seconds of protocol latency. **Requires MPC OS 3.10.1+*
